text:
olivia: Hey team — asking for a staged pinlift of runtime v2.15 for quant-v5 models in eu-west for the 6pm change window. We ran into a perf regression in longseq last week but QA fixed a probe; want to coordinate canary and rollback plan.

james: fyi what metrics did QA flag? latency or correctness?

olivia: it was tail latency at >1024 tokens on GPU-type-b. 99th went from 220ms -> 420ms on a few samples. QA pushed a kernel fallback that improved things in bench harness.

sofia: are there any model-only interactions? i.e., do we need to pin specific model variants while lifting runtime pin?

olivia: good call — we'll keep model pin for quant-v5b0 until canary completes. Only unpin runtime. models stay pinned to avoid mix.

nora: canary plan suggestion: 5% traffic for 30m in eu-west, run the longseq smoke set + embedding drift checks, then 20% for 1h. Auto-rollback on 5% increase in token-error or 15% increase in 99th latency vs baseline.

james: agree. Add a manual holdback if any new OOMs show up. Also we should capture KV cache hit rate to ensure no behavior regressions.

olivia: noted. I'll add KV cache telemetry and the smoke set link: https://redwood/qa/longseq-smoke (private).

deploybot: [deploybot] Received change request: runtime v2.15 -> unstaged-unpin on hosted-eu-west at 18:00 UTC. Canary policy: pct=5, duration=30m, metric-guards=[latency_99: +15%, token_error: +5%]. Rollback action: automatic -> runtime reverted.

sofia: can we include a soft-fallback to runtime v2.14 on error with gradual ramp? that buys us time while rollback happens.

olivia: yes — configuring fallback target to v2.14 and canary route group "staged-pinlift-eu". If auto-rollback triggers, we keep model pin unchanged.

james: commands i'll run pre-change (for oncall):
```
./infra/checks --env eu-west --smoke longseq-smoke
./telemetry/query "SELECT pct FROM latency_alerts WHERE job='runtime-canary'"
```

nora: I'll own watch during the 5% window and call for manual pause if KV miss rate >3x baseline.

olivia: thanks. I also drafted release notes blurb: "Runtime v2.15: kernel fallback for longsequence tail-latency; recommended for quant-v5b families. Model pins remain in-place during staged rollout." Any wording concerns?

sofia: add the canary metrics threshold and fallback mention. maybe: "canary: eu-west 5%/30m, auto-rollback triggers on latency_99 +15% or token_error +5%."

olivia: updated.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary started at 18:00:00 UTC (thread 1769998888). Route: staged-pinlift-eu, pct=5. Monitoring id=cb-176999.

nora: first 10m: no errors, latency_99 trending +3%. KV miss steady. embedding drift checks running (10/18 passed so far).

james: seeing 1 minor WARN in kvcache logs, not an OOM:
```
W 18:07 runtime-kv: missing-prefix-fallback for model quant-v5b0 shard-3
```

sofia: probably benign, keep watching.

nora: 25m mark: embedding drift 14/18 pass, latency_99 +4%, token_error flat. no regression.

olivia: increasing to 20% for 1h per plan.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary ramp to 20% started at 18:32:15 UTC.

james: during ramp I'm seeing a small uptick in tail latency spikes on a subset of requests with seq>1500 — still within threshold but noisy. I've pinned a sample.

olivia: please paste sample and I'll file an eval issue if it's reproducible.

james: pasted.

nora: 45m into 20%: KV miss 1.1x baseline, latency_99 +6%, token_error +0.5%. No OOMs. embedding drift pass 16/18. rolling fine.

sofia: can we lift the runtime pin in release configs after the window closes? i.e., flip the default for hosted-eu-west to v2.15?

olivia: yes but we'll wait until end of the 1h observation. If no regressions, I'll submit the config flip with a 24h post-rollout watch.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary complete: success. No auto-rollback triggered. Next action: schedule config flip at 20:00 UTC unless a manual hold is posted.

olivia: scheduling config flip at 20:00. Rollback plan: immediate revert to runtime v2.14 via deploybot with a 3-minute rollout (fast). Oncall: james/nora.

nora: ack. I'll be available during flip.

james: ack. saving logs in case we need for postmortem.

olivia: thanks everyone — releasing release notes and change log after flip.

deploybot: [deploybot] Config flip executed at 20:00:03 UTC. New default runtime for hosted-eu-west: v2.15 (models still pinned).

sofia: canary and flip look good from my side. I'll add a short note to the SDK compatibility doc mentioning the runtime change and the model pin policy.

olivia: closing thread; will open follow-up if any regressions surface. :white_check_mark:
